chapterTitle: Chapter 9: Periodic Table, Periodicity & Element Groups

questions.question: The periodic law states that the properties of elements are a periodic function of their:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Atomic number'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Periodic Table, Periodicity & Element Groups.

questions.question: Which of the following groups contains only non-metals?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Group 17'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Periodic Table, Periodicity & Element Groups.

questions.question: Which of the following elements has the largest atomic radius?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'K'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Periodic Table, Periodicity & Element Groups.

questions.question: Which group of elements is known as the halogens?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Group 17'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Periodic Table, Periodicity & Element Groups.

questions.question: Which of the following elements is a noble gas?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Argon'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Periodic Table, Periodicity & Element Groups.

questions.question: The ionization energy generally increases across a period due to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Increasing nuclear charge'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Periodic Table, Periodicity & Element Groups.

questions.question: Which element has the highest electronegativity?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Fluorine'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Periodic Table, Periodicity & Element Groups.

questions.question: The atomic number of an element corresponds to the number of:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Protons'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Periodic Table, Periodicity & Element Groups.

questions.question: Which of the following elements is a metalloid?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Silicon'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Periodic Table, Periodicity & Element Groups.

questions.question: The elements in the same group of the periodic table have similar:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Electron configurations'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Periodic Table, Periodicity & Element Groups.

questions.question: The transition elements are located in which block of the periodic table?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'd-block'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Periodic Table, Periodicity & Element Groups.

questions.question: Which of the following elements has the smallest atomic radius?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Li'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Periodic Table, Periodicity & Element Groups.

questions.question: Which element in Period 3 has the highest ionization energy?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Chlorine'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Periodic Table, Periodicity & Element Groups.

questions.question: Which of the following trends occurs as you move down a group in the periodic table?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Ionization energy decreases'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Periodic Table, Periodicity & Element Groups.

questions.question: The periodic table was first arranged by:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Mendeleev'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Periodic Table, Periodicity & Element Groups.

questions.question: The Lanthanides and Actinides are placed separately in the periodic table because:

options.C: Their properties do not fit in any other group

questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Their properties do not fit in any other group'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Periodic Table, Periodicity & Element Groups.

questions.question: Which of the following is a characteristic of noble gases?

options.C: They have complete outer electron shells

questions.explanation:
Correct answer: 'They have complete outer electron shells'. CHCl₃ contains three halogen atoms attached to the same carbon
                                                     CH₃CH₂CH₂O      CH₃CH₂CH₂B        CH₃CH₂CH₂N

questions.question: Which of the following elements is in Group 2 of the periodic table?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Calcium'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Periodic Table, Periodicity & Element Groups.

questions.question: Which of the following elements has the highest atomic number?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Sodium'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Periodic Table, Periodicity & Element Groups.

questions.question: Which of the following is a property of alkali metals?

options.C: They are good conductors of heat and electricity

questions.explanation:
Correct answer: 'They are good conductors of heat and electricity'. CHCl₃ contains three halogen atoms attached to the same carbon
                                                     CH₃CH₂CH₂O      CH₃CH₂CH₂B        CH₃CH₂CH₂N

questions.question: As you move across a period, the ionization energy of elements generally:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Increases'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Periodic Table, Periodicity & Element Groups.

questions.explanation:

questions.question: The electronegativity of an element increases as you move:

options.B: Across a period from left to right
options.C: From right to left in a period
options.D: From left to right in a group

questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Across a period from left to right'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Periodic Table, Periodicity & Element Groups.

questions.question: Which group of elements has the smallest atomic radius?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Halogens'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Periodic Table, Periodicity & Element Groups.

questions.question: Which of the following is true for elements across a period?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Electron affinity increases'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Periodic Table, Periodicity & Element Groups.

questions.question: The first ionization energy of oxygen is higher than that of sulfur because:

options.B: Oxygen has a smaller atomic radius

questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Oxygen has a smaller atomic radius'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Periodic Table, Periodicity & Element Groups.

questions.question: As you move down Group 17, the atomic radius of halogens:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Increases'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Periodic Table, Periodicity & Element Groups.

questions.question: Which element has the smallest ionization energy in Period 3?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Na'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Periodic Table, Periodicity & Element Groups.

questions.question: The trend of increasing atomic radius down a group is mainly due to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Increased electron shielding'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Periodic Table, Periodicity & Element Groups.

questions.question: The effective nuclear charge increases as you move:

options.C: From left to right within a group

questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Across a period'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Periodic Table, Periodicity & Element Groups.
